selection_reason: both residuals <= 1e-2; tie-break: fewer iterations then objective
hard_stopping_note: HiWA records/stops only Rg_norm; it does not retain a local-global primal ADMM residual or per-iteration objective curve.
consensus_note: SoftHiWA uses the same multiplier update as HiWA; rho proxy is mu/d under the implemented consensus scaling.
